arabic_title: الصَّلَاةُ عَلَى حَمَلَةِ الْعَرْشِ و كلّ مَلَكٍ مقرّبٍ
english_title: 3. Blessings on Bearers of throne & angels

phrases.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ وَحَمَلَةُ عَرْشِكَ الَّذِينَ لا يَفْتُرُونَ مِنْ تَسْبِيحِكَ،
phrases.english: 1.O God, as for the Bearers of Your Throne, who never flag in glorifying You,

phrases.arabic: وَلا يَسْـأَمُـونَ مِنْ تَقْـدِيْسِكَ،
phrases.english: 2.never become weary of calling You holy,

phrases.arabic: وَلا يَسْتَحسِرُونَ مِنْ عِبَادَتِكَ،
phrases.english: 3.never tire of worshipping You,

phrases.arabic: وَلاَ يُؤْثِرُونَ التَّقْصِيرَ عَلَى الْجِدِّ فِي أَمْرِكَ،
phrases.english: 4.never prefer curtailment over diligence in Your command,

phrases.arabic: وَلا يَغْفُلُونَ عَنِ الْوَلَهِ إلَيْكَ.
phrases.english: 5.and are never heedless of passionate love for You;

phrases.arabic: وَإسْرافِيْلُ صَاحِبُ الصُّوْرِ، الشَّاخِصُ الَّذِي يَنْتَظِرُ
phrases.english: 6.Seraphiel, the Owner of the Trumpet, fixed in his gaze, awaiting

phrases.arabic: مِنْكَ الاذْنَ وَحُلُولَ الامْرِ، فَيُنَبِّهُ بِالنَّفْخَةِ
phrases.english: 7.Your permission and the descent of the Command, that he may arouse through the Blast

phrases.arabic: صَرْعى رَهَائِنِ الْقُبُورِ. وَمِيكَآئِيلُ ذُو الْجَاهِ عِنْدَكَ،
phrases.english: 8.the hostages thrown down in the graves; Michael, possessor of standing with You

phrases.arabic: وَالْمَكَانِ الرَّفِيعِ مِنْ طَاعَتِكَ.
phrases.english: 9.and a raised up place in Your obedience;

phrases.arabic: وَجِبْريلُ الامِينُ عَلَى وَحْيِكَ،
phrases.english: 10.Gabriel, entrusted with Your revelation,

phrases.arabic: الْمُطَاعُ فِي أَهْلِ سَمَاوَاتِكَ،
phrases.english: 11.obeyed by the inhabitants of Your heavens,

phrases.arabic: الْمَكِينُ لَدَيْكَ، الْمُقَرَّبُ عِنْدَكَ،
phrases.english: 12.distinguished in Your Presence, brought nigh to You;

phrases.arabic: وَالرُّوحُ الَّذِي هُوَ عَلَى مَلائِكَةِ الْحُجُبِ،
phrases.english: 13.the spirit who is over the angels of the veils;

phrases.arabic: وَالرُّوحُ الَّذِي هُوَ مِنْ أَمْرِكَ.
phrases.english: 14.and the spirit who is of Your command -

phrases.arabic: أَللَّهُمَّ فَصَلِّ عليهم وَعَلَى الْمَلاَئِكَـةِ
phrases.english: 15.O God! bless them and the angels below them:

phrases.arabic: الَّـذِينَ مِنْ دُونِهِمْ مِنْ سُكَّـانِ سَمَاوَاتِكَ
phrases.english: 16.the residents in Your heavens,

phrases.arabic: وَأَهْلِ الامَانَةِ عَلَى رِسَالاَتِكَ،
phrases.english: 17.those entrusted with Your messages,

phrases.arabic: وَالَّذِينَ لا تَدْخُلُهُمْ سَأْمَةٌ مِنْ دؤُوب ،
phrases.english: 18.those who become not wearied by perseverance,

phrases.arabic: وَلاَ إعْيَاءٌ مِنْ لُغُوب وَلاَ فُتُورٌ،
phrases.english: 19.or exhausted and flagged by toil,

phrases.arabic: وَلاَ تَشْغَلُهُمْ عَنْ تَسْبِيحِكَ الشَّهَوَاتُ،
phrases.english: 20.whom passions distract not from glorifying You,

phrases.arabic: وَلا يَقْطَعُهُمْ عَنْ تَعْظِيمِكَ سَهْوُ الْغَفَـلاَتِ،
phrases.english: 21.and whose magnification of You is never cut off by the inattention of heedless moments;

phrases.arabic: الْخُشَّعُ الابْصارِ فلا يَرُومُونَ النَّظَرَ إلَيْكَ ،
phrases.english: 22.their eyes lowered, they do not attempt to look at You;

phrases.arabic: النَّواكِسُ الاذْقانِ الَّذِينَ قَدْ طَالَتْ رَغْبَتُهُمْ فِيمَا لَدَيْكَ
phrases.english: 23.their chins bowed, they have long desired what is with You;

phrases.arabic: الْمُسْتَهْتِرُونَ بِذِكْرِ آلائِكَ
phrases.english: 24.unrestrained in mentioning Your boons,

phrases.arabic: وَالْمُتَوَاضِعُونَ دُونَ عَظَمَتِكَ وَجَلاَلِ كِبْرِيآئِكَ
phrases.english: 25.they remain humble before Your mightiness and the majesty of Your magnificence;

phrases.arabic: وَالَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ إذَا نَظَرُوا إلَى جَهَنَّمَ تَزْفِرُ  عَلَى أَهْلِ مَعْصِيَتِكَ:
phrases.english: 26.those who say when they look upon Gehenna roaring over the people who disobeyed You:

phrases.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ مَا عَبَدْنَاكَ حَقَّ عِبَـادَتِكَ.
phrases.english: 27.'Glory be to You, we have not worshipped You with the worship You deservest!'

phrases.arabic: فَصَـلِّ عَلَيْهِمْ وَعَلَى الرَّوْحَانِيِّينَ مِنْ مَلائِكَتِكَ،
phrases.english: 28.Bless them, and Your angels who are the Reposeful,

phrases.arabic: وَ أهْلِ الزُّلْفَةِ عِنْدَكَ، وَحُمَّالِ الْغَيْبِ إلى رُسُلِكَ،
phrases.english: 29.those of proximity to You, those who carry the unseen to Your messengers,

phrases.arabic: وَالْمُؤْتَمَنِينَ على وَحْيِكَ وَقَبائِلِ الْمَلائِكَةِ الَّذِينَ اخْتَصَصْتَهُمْ لِنَفْسِكَ،
phrases.english: 30.those entrusted with Your revelation, the tribes of angels whom You hast singled out for Yourself,

phrases.arabic: وَأَغْنَيْتَهُمْ عَنِ الطَّعَامِ والشَّرَابِ بِتَقْدِيْسِكَ،
phrases.english: 31.freed from need for food and drink by their calling You holy,

phrases.arabic: وَأسْكَنْتَهُمْ بُطُونَ أطْبَـاقِ سَمَاوَاتِكَ،
phrases.english: 32.and made to dwell inside Your heavens' layers,

phrases.arabic: وَالّذينَ عَلَى أرْجَآئِهَا إذَا نَزَلَ الامْرُ بِتَمَامِ وَعْدِكَ،
phrases.english: 33.those who will stand upon the heavens' borders when the Command descends to complete Your promise,

phrases.arabic: وَخزّانِ الْمَطَرِ وَزَوَاجِرِ السَّحَابِ،
phrases.english: 34.the keepers of the rain, the drivers of the clouds,

phrases.arabic: وَالّذِي بِصَوْتِ زَجْرِهِ يُسْمَعُ زَجَلُ ألرُّعُوْدِ،
phrases.english: 35.him at whose driving's sound is heard the rolling of thunder,

phrases.arabic: وَإذَا سَبَحَتْ بِهِ حَفِيفَةُ السّحَـابِ الْتَمَعَتْ صَوَاعِقُ الْبُرُوقِ.
phrases.english: 36.and when the reverberating clouds swim before his driving, bolts of lightning flash;

phrases.arabic: وَمُشَيِّعِيْ الْثَلْجِ وَالْبَرَدِ. وَالْهَابِطِينَ مَعَ قَطْرِ الْمَطَر إَذَا نَزَلَ،
phrases.english: 37.the escorts of snow and hail, the descenders with the drops of rain when they fall,

phrases.arabic: وَالْقُوَّامِ عَلَى خَزَائِنِ الرّيَاحِ،
phrases.english: 38.the watchers over the treasuries of the winds,

phrases.arabic: وَ المُوَكَّلِينَ بِالجِبَالِ فَلا تَزُولُ.
phrases.english: 39.those charged with the mountains lest they disappear,

phrases.arabic: وَالَّذِينَ  عَرَّفْتَهُمْ مَثَاقِيلَ الْمِياهِ،
phrases.english: 40.those whom You hast taught the weights of the waters

phrases.arabic: وَكَيْلَ مَا تَحْوِيهِ لَوَاعِجُ الامْطَارِ وَعَوَالِجُهَا،
phrases.english: 41.and the measures contained by torrents and masses of rain;

phrases.arabic: وَرُسُلِكَ مِنَ الْمَلائِكَةِ  إلَى أهْلِ الارْضِ بِمَكْرُوهِ مَا يَنْزِلُ مِنَ الْبَلاءِ،
phrases.english: 42.the angels who are Your messengers to the people of the earth with the disliked affliction that comes down

phrases.arabic: وَمَحْبُوبِ الرَّخَآءِ، والسَّفَرَةِ الْكِرَامِ اَلبَرَرَةِ،
phrases.english: 43.and the beloved ease; the devoted, noble scribes,

phrases.arabic: وَالْحَفَظَةِ الْكِرَامِ الْكَاتِبِينَ، وَمَلَكِ الْمَوْتِ وَأعْوَانِهِ،
phrases.english: 44.the watchers, noble writers, the angel of death and his helpers,

phrases.arabic: وَمُنْكَر وَنَكِير، وَرُومَانَ فَتَّانِ الْقُبُورِ،
phrases.english: 45.Munkar and Nakir, Rumaan, the tester in the graves,

phrases.arabic: وَالطَّائِفِينَ بِالبَيْتِ الْمَعْمُورِ، وَمَالِك،
phrases.english: 46.the circlers of the Inhabited House, Malik

phrases.arabic: وَالْخَزَنَةِ، وَرُضْوَانَ، وَسَدَنَةِ الْجِنَانِ
phrases.english: 47.and the guardians, Ridwan and the gatekeepers of the gardens,

phrases.arabic: وَالَّذِيْنَ لاَ يَعْصُوْنَ اللّهَ مَا أمَرَهُمْ وَيَفْعَلُونَ مَا يُؤْمَرُونَ.
phrases.english: 48.those who "disobey not God in What He commands them and do What they are commanded" (66:6);

phrases.arabic: وَالَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ: سَلاَمٌ عَلَيْكُمْ بِمَا صَبَرْتُمْ فَنِعْمَ عُقْبَى الـدّارِ.
phrases.english: 49.those who say, "Peace be upon you, for that you were patient - and fair is the Ultimate Abode" (13:24);

phrases.arabic: والزّبانيةُ الذّينَ إذَا قِيْـلَ لَهُمْ: خُذُوهُ فَغُلُّوْهُ
phrases.english: 50.the Zabaniya, who, when it is said to them, "take him, and fetter him,

phrases.arabic: ثُمَّ الْجَحِيمَ صَلُّوْهُ ابْتَدَرُوهُ سِرَاعاً وَلَمْ يُنْظِرُوهُ.
phrases.english: 51.then roast him in hell" (69:30), hasten to accomplish it, nor do they give him any respite;

phrases.arabic: وَمَنْ أوْهَمْنَا ذِكْرَهُ، وَلَمْ نَعْلَمْ مَكَانَهُ مِنْكَ،
phrases.english: 52.him whom we have failed to mention, not knowing his place with You,

phrases.arabic: وَبأيِّ أمْر وَكَّلْتَهُ. وَسُكّانُ الْهَوَآءِ  وَالارْضِ وَالمآءِ،
phrases.english: 53.nor with which command You hast charged him; and the residents in the air, the earth, and the water,

phrases.arabic: وَمَنْ مِنْهُمْ عَلَى الْخَلْقِ فَصَلِّ عَلَيْهِمْ
phrases.english: 54.and those of them charged over the creatures; bless them

phrases.arabic: يَوْمَ تَأْتي كُلُّ نَفْس مَعَهَا سَائِقٌ  وَشَهِيدٌ،
phrases.english: 55.on the day when "every soul will come, with it a driver and a witness" (50:21),

phrases.arabic: وَصَلّ عَلَيْهِمْ صَلاَةً تَزِيدُهُمْ كَرَامَةً عَلى كَرَامَتِهِمْ،
phrases.english: 56.and bless them with a blessing that will add honour to their honour

phrases.arabic: وَطَهَارَةً عَلَى طَهَارَتِهِمْ
phrases.english: 57.and purity to their purity.

phrases.arabic: اللّهُمَّ  وَإذَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى مَلاَئِكَتِكَ وَرُسُلِكَ،
phrases.english: 58.O God, and when You blessest Your angels and Your messengers

phrases.arabic: وَبَلَّغْتَهُمْ صَلاَتَنَا عَلَيْهِمْ، فَصَلِّ عَلَينا
phrases.english: 59.and You extendest our blessings to them, bless us

phrases.arabic: بِمَا فَتَحْتَ لَنَا مِنْ حُسْنِ الْقَوْلِ فِيْهِمْ إنَّكَ جَوَاْدٌ كَرِيمٌ .
phrases.english: 60.through the good words about them which You hast opened up for us! You art Munificent, Generous.
